title: Du'a for everything
hook: Big or small, any language, any time. Allah is listening.

screens.text: On Day 6 you wrote your first **du'a** (a personal prayer to Allah). Since then you've learned the set words of the prayer. Today: the words that are all yours, to take with you past Day 90.

**Allah asks you to ask.**

> "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." [Q 40:60, Saheeh Intl.]

The Prophet ﷺ said du'a is itself worship, then recited this verse [Abu Dawud 1479].

screens.prompt: Fact, or a myth that stops people asking?

items.why: The Prophet ﷺ said so, then recited the verse you just read [Abu Dawud 1479].

items.text: Du'a is for big things only
items.why: Ask for anything: a parking spot, a calm exam, your mom's health. Nothing is too small for Allah.
Outside the set words of the prayer, ask in any language. Allah understands every one.

items.text: I asked and nothing happened, so it doesn't work
items.why: Du'a is answered as long as you don't grow impatient and give up [Muslim 2735]. Keep asking.

items.text: I'm too new, or I've messed up too much, for Allah to listen
items.why: He answers whoever calls Him [Q 2:186]. Al-Mujib, the One who answers, isn't waiting for you to be perfect.

screens.text:
**He's near, and He's listening.**

> "Indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me." [Q 2:186, Saheeh Intl.]

screens.title: A simple shape for du'a
screens.intro: The Prophet ﷺ taught this to a man who rushed his du'a [Tirmidhi 3477].

steps.text: Raise your hands, if you like. That's a sunnah too [Abu Dawud 1488].
Praise Allah: thank Him for something.
Send blessings on the Prophet ﷺ.
Ask for whatever you need, in your own words.

screens.done_text: That's it. Thank, send blessings, ask. Any time, anywhere.

screens.prompt: Put the shape of a du'a in order.
items: Send blessings on the Prophet ﷺ
screens.feedback: Right. Praise first, then blessings, then ask [Tirmidhi 3477].

screens.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
screens.meaning: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm on Your religion
screens.when: Any time, especially on low days. The Prophet ﷺ said it often [Tirmidhi 2140]. A du'a for staying steady, long after Day 90.

screens.text: Tap each time you say it, slowly, thinking of the meaning. Three is just for practice; once is enough any time you need it.

phrases.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
phrases.meaning: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm on Your religion

screens.text: **Pray for others too.** When you make du'a for someone who isn't there, an angel says, "And the same for you" [Muslim 2732].
bubbles: Pray for your family by name, including for their guidance.
Abu Hurayrah asked the Prophet ﷺ to pray for his mother, who wasn't Muslim. She later accepted Islam [Muslim 2491].
Your du'a for them is a quiet kindness nobody can stop.

screens.situation: Destiny has made du'a for a job for three months. Nothing yet. She's starting to think Allah isn't listening to her.

options.text: Keep asking, keep applying, and trust Allah with the timing
options.feedback: Yes. Do your part and trust Allah [Tirmidhi 2517]. He answers in His way and time, so don't give up asking.

options.text: Stop asking; it's clearly not meant to be
options.feedback: Not quite. Giving up asking is the one thing the Prophet ﷺ warned against [Muslim 2735].

options.text: Decide she's not a good enough Muslim to be heard
options.feedback: Not quite. Allah answers whoever calls Him [Q 2:186]. A delay isn't a rejection of her.

screens.prompt: Look back at the first du'a you wrote on Day 6. Then write a du'a list for now: one thing for yourself, one person you love, and one for who you want to be a year from now. Private to you.

chips: What are good times to make du'a?
Can I make du'a for my non-Muslim family?
Teach me another short du'a from the Prophet ﷺ
Why hasn't my du'a been answered?

screens.text: One du'a after every prayer today.
steps: After each prayer, before you get up, make one du'a from your list
screens.optional_extra: Make a du'a for one person by name who doesn't know you're doing it.

screens.text: Ask Allah for everything, in any words, and keep asking. Du'a is worship.
The program ends in two days. The conversation with Allah doesn't end at all.

check.prompt: Can you make du'a in English, for something small?

options.text: Yes. Du'a can be in any language, about anything
options.feedback: Right. Only the set words of the prayer are in Arabic. Your du'a is yours.

options.text: No. Only in Arabic, and only for serious needs
options.feedback: Not quite. Allah hears every language, and nothing is too small to ask.

check.prompt: What does the Prophet ﷺ say about a du'a that seems unanswered?

options.text: Don't grow impatient and stop asking
options.feedback: Right. Du'a is answered as long as you don't give up [Muslim 2735].

options.text: It means Allah has rejected you
options.feedback: Not quite. He answers whoever calls [Q 2:186]. Keep asking.

aiContext:
**Lesson facts**
- Allah commands du'a and promises to respond [Q 40:60]; He is near and answers the caller [Q 2:186]. Du'a is worship [Abu Dawud 1479].
- A shape for du'a: praise Allah, send blessings on the Prophet ﷺ, then ask [Tirmidhi 3477]. Raising the hands is a sunnah [Abu Dawud 1488].
- Du'a is answered as long as one doesn't grow impatient and stop [Muslim 2735]. Pair du'a with effort and trust [Tirmidhi 2517].
- Du'a for someone absent: an angel says "and for you the same" [Muslim 2732]. Du'a for a non-Muslim relative's guidance is good [Muslim 2491].
- Today's phrase: *Ya muqallibal-qulub, thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik* [Tirmidhi 2140].
- Personal du'a may be in any language outside the prayer's set words.

**Likely questions**
- *"Good times for du'a?"* Keep it simple: after the prayers, and any time at all. Don't list times without a bank reference; offer to look deeper with the imam.
- *"Can I pray for my non-Muslim family?"* Yes, for their guidance, health and good, while they live [Muslim 2491]. For a relative who has died, follow Day 77's guidance and Q23.
- *"Why hasn't my du'a been answered?"* Gentle: keep asking [Muslim 2735]; Allah knows what's best and when; keep doing your part [Tirmidhi 2517]. Never suggest they're unworthy.
- *"Another short du'a?"* Offer *Rabbana atina…* (Day 28) [Q 2:201; Bukhari 6389] or today's phrase. Don't supply du'a text that isn't in the Citation Bank.
- *"Can I make personal du'a in English inside the prayer?"* Escalate gently: schools differ on du'a in other languages within the obligatory prayer; the safe default is Arabic phrases inside the prayer and personal du'a in any language after it.

**Escalate:** du'a for a deceased non-Muslim relative (Q23); requests for "special du'as" to fix marriage, money or illness (care first; professional help where needed; imam for the rest).

**Don't**
- Don't promise a specific outcome from a du'a.
- Don't imply unanswered du'a means Allah is angry or the convert is unworthy.
- Don't recommend du'a "packages," amulets or paid prayers.
